![Ex Machinis](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/anSnGwH7/images/bb987916f6d1efc0ba9dc8ad9abc6a97c3408045.png "Ex Machinis")

[Ex Deorum](https://modrinth.com/mod/ex-deorum "Ex Deorum") 的自动化扩展模组。添加了由 RF 供电的筛子、锤子和压缩机。

此模组不提供能源生成——你需要使用其他模组来提供能源，例如 [Thermal Expansion](https://modrinth.com/mod/thermal-expansion "Thermal Expansion") 或 [Powah! Rearchitected](https://modrinth.com/mod/powah "Powah! Rearchitected")。

图片中的模组：[CobbleForDays](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cobblefordays "CobbleForDays")、[Pipez](https://modrinth.com/mod/pipez "Pipez")、[Thermal Expansion](https://modrinth.com/mod/thermal-expansion "Thermal Expansion")。
